rounds.periodEn: Period: According to university TCAS Portfolio announcements
roundSpecificRequirementsEn: Graduates from core curriculum high schools
International / Vocational / Non-formal / GED credentials not accepted
Must meet minimum GPAX and credit requirements
Certain sub-projects require graduation in the current academic year
Certain sub-projects have special health requirements (e.g., no color blindness)
